generic_domain.justification: Classification is a broad research domain in machine learning that deals with assigning predefined categories to inputs. The specific domains listed, such as document classification, node classification, and text classification, are all sub-domains within the broader classification research area. Document classification focuses on categorizing documents based on their content; node classification involves labeling nodes in graphs or networks; text classification is about labeling textual data into predefined classes. All these fall under the umbrella of classification tasks.
